system.description:
• Effect: Out of turn, when a nonmagical missile would hit you (not a siege weapon), make a Dexterity check (d20 + Dexterity modifier) against the attack roll; on a success it does no damage.
  • Attempts per round: the table above.
  • You need a free hand, and can't deflect while surprised or Incapacitated.
  • 5th level: a melee attack too
  • 7th level: on a success against a melee attack, you may hold the weapon instead (the attacker takes it back with a Strength contest)
  • 10th level: a magical missile too, such as an enchanted arrow or a spell that makes a ranged attack roll

activities.name: Deflect
activities.text: Out of turn, when a {1:nonmagical missile, 10:missile (a magical one too, such as an enchanted arrow or a spell's ranged attack)} would hit you{5:, or a melee attack}: against the attack roll; on a success it does no damage{7:, and against a melee attack you may hold the weapon instead}. Up to {2:1, 6:2, 11:3, 16:4, 20:5} a round. Needs a free hand; not while surprised or Incapacitated.
